propositions: Eval/calibration surface excludes activated project code-review criteria; _code_review_prompt_id only admits static built-in physical ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through default plan-review namespace and lacks code-review membership branch
_code_review_prompt_id must accept optional repo_root parameter and admit both built-in physical ids and logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root)
calibrate_criterion must select code-review arm when repo_root is not None and criterion_id is active, resolving via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key=code_review
Active project code-review criterion with missing eval spec must raise EvalError containing the logical criterion_id and eval-spec path
Plan-review criteria with non-None repo_root must follow unchanged calibration path; built-in admission without repo_root remains unchanged
